reviews.comment: The exams in this class are ridiculously easy. The lectures are surprisingly interesting, which is good because only 3 absences are allowed. She is a bit highschool-y with her phone and attendance policy, but the lectures and how easy the class is far outweigh the negatives. Certainly an easy A class.

One of the best profs I've ever had. Study guides you can use on exams, amazing lectures, and up to 30 extra credit points. Show up because participation quizzes are password protected. Genuinely cares for her students!
Dr Paluka is muchhhhh better and nicer than Br Bouton

Prof Paluka was great for HIST 105. Definitely a lecture heavy class, so be sure to take a ton of notes. Tests were open note(I took her HIST 105 at Blinn), and she gave out a ton of extra credit. You could tell her passion for history, as most of the time she wouldn't even have notes to read off of, which I thought was pretty cool. Def recommend

My favorite professor that I have had! She provides a lot of extra credit opportunities and you're allowed up to three unexcused absences. The only assignments that weren't tests were taken during class, and she would guide us through them as we discussed all the questions together. It would be very hard to not get an A in the class.

THE BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD!!!!! I used to be failing in history, but I got an A+ with the way she taught the material. Attend all of her lectures and take notes because her lectures are exam material (along with the reading). She offers LOTS of extra credit. Her exams are simple/easy, and she asks NO tricky questions.

Go to class! is the biggest advice I can give. She provides attendance checks daily which will help with your grade. SO SO much extra credit opportunities and fairly easy exams that are based on her lectures; again, go to class. She is so kind and passionate about history, wished she taught 106 too.

The best history professor I have had her lectures are engaging and you should do well in the course if you attend class and take good notes during the lecture. A ton of extra credit opportunities as well!

Professor Paluka's lectures were very engaging and I enjoyed her class. All of the exams are online and not difficult at all if you listen in lecture. She provides a ton of extra credit opportunities too, so there's no reason you shouldn't be able to get an A in her class.

TAKE PROF. PALUKA! She was the sweetest, caring, easiest professor and her teaching style is more like story telling in a lecture heavy way. She had tons of extra credit and anyone could talk to her. If I could've taken her for HIST106, I would've. Tests are online, open-note, and not bad at all! TAKE HER!!!

Very good interactive lectures, what's expected of you is very clear and easy to understand. There's many extra credit opportunities, and the assignments outside of exams are relatively easy, and require little reading compared to other classes. Attendance is taken, so you must go to class.
This class is lecture heavy but as long as you take good notes you will be fine. Definitely take her if you can! She offers a lot of extra credit opportunities

TAKE PROFESSOR PALUKA! Her class was just a requirement for my major, but completely unrelated to it, and yet, I enjoyed her class the most! She makes all tests and quizzes open note, and gives very engaging lectures! Just show up to class and you'll do great!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: TAKE PROFESSOR PALUKA!!!! History at A&M can be so hard. All quizzes and test are open book, open note. Show up to class, she lectures then you use your notes on exams and quizzes. It is not hard to get an A in this class. Be respectful during lectures. Extra credit offered every week. Goodluck if you get another professor besides Paluka.

i absolutely loved her class, i've never liked history but professor paluka made this class so enjoyable and interesting. you do not have to stress about exams because they are open note and as long as you show up and take notes you will get an A. best history class i've ever taken. there are 4 document analyses, 2 book quizzes, and 3 exams.

Professor Paluka is loved by so many and she makes it easy to want to engage and be successful in class. All tests and quizzes are open note. There is a textbook for the class and I found it helpful on tests, but not reading won't make it impossible. She is super understanding and great at communicating.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Paluka is a consistently great professor. She gives great lectures, making the subject genuinely interesting and almost like a reality tv show. Easy to be engaged, lots of guided analyses, and open note tests made this class very enjoyable.
Super easy class. All tests are open note. Primary document analysis is done in class. Plenty of extra credit opportunities. Definitely recommend!
Amazing professor, keeps lectures interesting and really cares about students. Offers a lot of extra credit and tests are what she says they will be.
Absolutely a great professor! Shes so caring and everything you do in class from lectures is what is on your exams! Very straight forward and super sweet!! Definitely recommend!!

Shes a great professor and gives a ton of easy extra credit opportunities. Attendance does matter and her exams are essay type questions and solely based on her lecture and assigned readings. A very easy class! Just show up and take notes and youll definitely get an A
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very nice professor. You must attend lecture as nothing is posted online to study. You MUST take notes, as exams are essay based and open-note. If you use any sources outside of her specific lectures to study/write for exam essays, you get a 0 (learned this the hard way). Lots of extra credit. Easy class as long as you attend and take good notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough good things about Prof Paluka, she's just a sweet lady. She does take attendance, and the tests are entirely based on the lectures she gives. Outside reading is done for quizzes, and extra credit is given for small assignments. Paluka is easy to talk to and cares about her students and class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT
